digest.component_or_area: automated quality audit and lint gate enforcement
propositions: Approved maintainability ratchets for function complexity (C901), Mypy settings, and Ruff rules cannot be enabled wholesale without resolving existing pre-existing diagnostics that would cause gate failures.

Four Mypy settings (no_implicit_optional, strict_equality, warn_redundant_casts, warn_unused_ignores) and Ruff ASYNC/DTZ families require baseline validation and integration testing before enforcement can be activated.

Child stories must execute in strict dependency order due to shared pyproject.toml ownership and test file creation/extension, with independent C901 story proceeding when no file conflicts are detected.

All enforced ratchet families (C901, Mypy flags, Ruff ASYNC/DTZ, Ruff RUF) must exit zero on the current origin/main tip before landing, and any drift introduced after story baselines must be resolved before the corresponding gate is activated.
